commercial intake migrations independently reviewed and applied with backup and rollback evidence
web and API origins deployed from reviewed immutable revisions
origin healthz and readyz return expected service and revision payloads
valid origin TLS proved without disabling certificate verification
Cloudflare records and routes applied through an authorized account connection
